{{Short description|Spanish radio journalist and popularizer of science}}
{{Other people|Ángel Rodríguez}}
'''Ángel Rodríguez Lozano''' is a Spanish radio journalist and popularizer of science, best known as the creator and presenter of the program [[Vanguardia de la Ciencia]], which was broadcast without interruption every week from April 1995 until June 2007.

Before the startup of Vanguardia de la Ciencia, he participated in other programs in [[Radio Nacional de España]]. He has also contributed to other programs of popular science, ''El Mono Temático'', ''En Clave de Ciencia de Radio 5'', and ''Hora América''. From August 2006 to June 2007, he also wrote and presented the program [[El Sueño de Arquímedes]].
Ángel Rodríguez Lozano was born in 1952 in the small municipality of [[La Garrovilla]], near [[Mérida, Spain|Mérida]] in [[Extremadura]]. He is a physicist by training, and has done research work in fluid dynamics, chaos theory and non-linear phenomena at the [[Complutense University of Madrid]].<ref>The biography of Ángel Rodríguez Lozano at the web site of Radio Nacional de España [http://www.vanguardia.rne.es/?go=111b735a516af85c9c789c7a4fd3f107a35c62168843087fd36ba7aa2d2b605d79bfad0a57f2b494b75f0d9df022583bbf4a37cbcdc51b1760b732aef2bc51ca258512135ee0ce4ca8a53c8364a53e4ae155d4087714dea3] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160122150936/http://www.vanguardia.rne.es/?go=111b735a516af85c9c789c7a4fd3f107a35c62168843087fd36ba7aa2d2b605d79bfad0a57f2b494b75f0d9df022583bbf4a37cbcdc51b1760b732aef2bc51ca258512135ee0ce4ca8a53c8364a53e4ae155d4087714dea3 |date=2016-01-22 }}</ref>
Ángel Rodríguez Lozano has stated that he enjoys popularizing science, because the effort that is required to present a scientific topic helps him put the concepts straight, and gain a deeper understanding of the subject matter.<ref>[http://www.dimetu.com/2008/02/20/retropodcast-12-entrevista-a-angel-rodriguez-lozano/ ¡DIME TÚ! — Entrevista a Ángel Rodríguez Lozano. First published June 30th, 2007.] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080318235400/http://www.dimetu.com/2008/02/20/retropodcast-12-entrevista-a-angel-rodriguez-lozano/ |date=2008-03-18 }} ''"Desde pequeñito eso del enseñar a mi siempre me ha gustado. El esfuerzo mental que tenía que hacer para colocar en orden las ideas y poderlas expresar de manera que otros las entendieran, eso, de alguna manera organizaba mi propia mente y me hacia comprender las cosas."''</ref>

Ángel Rodríguez Lozano left Radio Nacional in June, 2007, because of a re-structuration of the company,<ref>Correspondence section at the end of the program Vanguardia de la Ciencia of June 9, 2007. [http://www.vanguardia.rne.es/FRONT_PROGRAMAS?go=111b735a516af85ccdc4135d9df82c2e123009d61eb00f778b60af793b191c3165595f12f857fccf8fc4680324c44c505f04bbcd924eb3a14791bd690da53e204c2a972065f8551b] {{Webarchive|url=https://archive.today/20121209052256/http://www.vanguardia.rne.es/FRONT_PROGRAMAS?go=111b735a516af85ccdc4135d9df82c2e123009d61eb00f778b60af793b191c3165595f12f857fccf8fc4680324c44c505f04bbcd924eb3a14791bd690da53e204c2a972065f8551b |date=2012-12-09 }}</ref> which involved the early retirement of employees older than 52 years.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.dimetu.com/2008/02/20/retropodcast-12-entrevista-a-angel-rodriguez-lozano/ |title=¡DIME TÚ! — Entrevista a Ángel Rodríguez Lozano. |access-date=2008-02-23 |archive-date=2008-03-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080318235400/http://www.dimetu.com/2008/02/20/retropodcast-12-entrevista-a-angel-rodriguez-lozano/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== cienciaes.com ==

In 2009, Ángel Rodríguez launched the web site "cienciaes.com" (Ciencia para escuchar - science for listening). The site contains audio files about science. It is divided into the sections "Hablando con cientificos" (interviews with scientists), "ciencia y genios" (biographies of scientists), "zoo de fosiles" (paleontology), "la ciencia nuestra de cada dia" (the science of everyday phenomena)       and "Ulises y la ciencia" (reflections on scientific themes). In addition, some episodes of ''Vanguardia de la Ciencia'' and ''El  sueno de Arquimedes'', previously aired by [[Radio Nacional de España|RNE]], are available for download. All the contents of Cienciaes.com are licensed under a [[Creative Commons licences|Creative Commons license]].
